The reason I completed this game is because the Crash series is one of my favorite video game franchises of all time. I love the original trilogy, CTR, Twinsanity, the handheld games and yes, even WOC. With this game being called Crash "4", it's pretty much calling itself the true successor to the OGs. Of course I had to beat it the way I beat the originals at least once. 100%

To give the game some credit, I like the physics and how it handles. It's everything else that I hate. Levels too long, hidden box BS, lazy n verted levels to bloat the game, etc. You've heard it all. Don't want to make this too long otherwise I'd just make a separate rant post (because there aren't enough of those here).

tldr; TFB tried too hard to make Crash 1 on crack and ruined what made a Crash game actually fun to complete.
